name: TileGroup

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Specify the the value of <RadioTile> to be selected by default

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the group is disabled

props.name: legend
props.description: Provide an optional legend for this group

props.name: name
props.description: Specify the name of the underlying `<input>` nodes

props.name: required
props.description: `true` to specify if input selection in group is required.

props.name: valueSelected
props.description: Specify the value that is currently selected in the group

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TileGroup rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
